notes: A calmer, more cinematic LATYS. Agent cards now show the agent's terminal live under one status line. Agent Forge, Workflows, Mission Control, Time Machine and Settings all open with the same scene change. Dev, Build, Test and Release are now one Run menu, layouts moved to the canvas controls, and the status bar only shows what has happened. Forge Academy opens with a summary of the agent: its version, exams passed and what to do next. Buttons and the warning and error colours now match across the app.
